# BlockFlow

> Playwright-compatible automation in your browser. A browser extension (Chrome/Brave/Edge, Firefox)
> for end-to-end tests, form filling, scraping and monitoring, built from connected blocks in an editor
> or written as JSON scripts (a list of steps) that users import. Import checks every file strictly and
> names each problem with a code and a JSON path, so a model can repair its own script.

To generate or explain workflows, read in this order:

- [Usage guide](docs/guide/README.md): start with "Rules for AI tools" and "Script format (write this)". Write the script format: a list of steps, compiled to blocks on import
- [Block reference](docs/guide/blocks.md): every block type, its config keys, defaults and outputs (generated from the code)
- [Block reference, JSON](docs/guide/blocks.json)
- [Script JSON Schema](docs/guide/script.schema.json): the format to write (unknown keys are errors)
- [Workflow JSON Schema](docs/guide/workflow.schema.json): the graph format the editor exports
- [Repair table](docs/guide/README.md#repair-what-import-errors-mean): import refuses a broken file and lists each problem as `<level> <code> at <JSON path>: <message> <hint>`; fix every path it names and answer with the whole corrected file
- [Example workflows](docs/guide/examples/): each as a script (`*.script.json`) and a graph (`*.blockflow.json`), checked by tests
- To run and repair workflows yourself in the user's browser: the MCP server `blockflow-mcp` (tools `snapshot_page`, `validate_workflow`, `run_workflow`, `get_report`…; needs Settings → Allow outside control and `npx blockflow-bridge install`), see [MCP Server](docs/wiki/MCP-Server.md). In CI: the `blockflow` CLI, see [CLI](docs/wiki/CLI.md)
- Element locators: prefer `role=button[name="Sign in"]`, `label=Email`, `text=…`, `testid=…` over CSS (guide section 4)

To change BlockFlow's code:

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): commands and codebase rules
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Internals wiki](docs/wiki/Home.md): file-by-file reference of the code
- [Plan](docs/PLAN.md) and [implementation plan and status](docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md)
